description: We are Girls Who Code at BCC. Our team is interested in coding, web development, games, and space. We are excited to learn and build something exciting and important.
summary: We developed an interactive web-based space weather survival simulation that uses data and turns it into a high-stakes mission. Using data sourced from NASA’s Space Weather Database (DONKI), players act as Junior Space Commander tracking incoming threats like solar flares (FLR), coronal mass ejections (ICME), and high-speed streams (HSS). Each day, players must analyze threat tables and make strategic choices that directly impact critical ship systems—balancing power, oxygen, and radiation levels to survive without hitting fatal thresholds. To bridge complex data with accessible gameplay, our interface integrates interactive definitions that educate players on real solar phenomena as they play. This project addresses the challenge by reforming raw complexed scientific datasets into an engaging, playable experience, demonstrating how decisions can directly affect an astronaut, spacecraft, and mission infrastructure during space operations.
details:
• What it does & How it works: Mars Outpost is an interactive web-based space simulation game. Players act as Martian base commanders navigating emergency crisis scenarios (such as solar storms or airlock leaks) via a retro Terminal UI. Player decisions directly impact real-time resource meters for oxygen, power, and radiation, while a built-in table model utilizes space weather data.
  • Tools & Technologies: Built using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and NASA DONKI telemetry data.
  • Benefits & Intended Impact: It serves as an educational tool that promotes STEM engagement, critical thinking, and problem-solving through immersive, gamified active learning.
  • Creativity & Considerations: The project bridges the gap between entertainment and real-world science by embedding live NASA telemetry into a narrative choice-driven game. Key factors considered included intuitive UI design, responsive state management for smooth screen transitions, and balanced risk-and-reward mechanics for player choices.
